title: Art thou real, my ideal?
html_source:
from Allusions in Ulysses: An Annotated List
By Weldon Thornton,(p. 87).

Joyce quoted this stanza more fully in “Stephen Hero”:
Art thou real my ideal
Wilt thou ever come to me
In the soft and gentel twilight
With your baby on your knee.
